title: 香港创新科技署：河套园区吸引百家企，跨境创新要素自由流动？
speaker: Kevin Choi

segments.en: AI helps in research. Well, getting aside, what kind of commitments have you received so far in the last 12 months from foreign companies, whether they've signed leases?
segments.zh: 人工智能助力研究。那么，抛开这点，过去12个月里，你们从外国公司获得了哪些承诺，无论它们是否已签署租约？

segments.en: I know leases are not cheap. For example, I would take a look at Hong Kong Park as an example to showcase that the commitments are coming up and also the market confidence is picking up.
segments.zh: 我知道租金不便宜。例如，我会以香港园区为例，展示承诺正在增加，市场信心也在提升。

segments.en: The Loop Hong Kong Park actually only commenced operation last December, so it's only a few months or shorter than a year,
segments.zh: 香港园区实际上去年12月才开始运营，所以只有几个月或不到一年，

segments.en: but it already attracts a hundred enterprises to join the park within, I only got two wet-lap border-tree buildings to fill and they all fill up by now.
segments.zh: 但它已经吸引了100家企业加入园区，我只有两栋湿实验室大楼要填满，现在都已填满。

segments.en: I have been building five more buildings and we are already entering into the pre-rending agreements and quite some of them have already done the pre-rends part of it.
segments.zh: 我正在建造另外五栋大楼，我们已经开始签订预租协议，其中不少已经完成了预租部分。

segments.en: Furthermore, beyond that, we are also tendering out some land parcels for private sector
segments.zh: 此外，除此之外，我们还在招标一些地块给私营部门

segments.en: to directly build their own laboratories.
segments.zh: 直接建造他们自己的实验室。

segments.en: We have sent out five packages and we have received like 15 submissions.
segments.zh: 我们已经发出了五个项目包，收到了大约15份提交。

segments.en: So they are all very high quality submissions from real scientific research and development companies.
segments.zh: 所以它们都是来自真正科研开发公司的高质量提交。

segments.en: They want to build laboratories and also they want to build themselves.
segments.zh: 他们想建造实验室，也想建立自己的设施。

segments.en: So it is a very strong commitment from the private sector that they believe in Hong Kong's IND initiative and also believes in Loop Hong Kong Park because Loop Hong Kong Park is not just a Hong Kong initiative.
segments.zh: 因此，私营部门做出了非常坚定的承诺，他们相信香港的IND倡议，也相信河套香港园区，因为河套香港园区不仅仅是香港的倡议。

segments.en: It's a national one, that the national government has already pledged.
segments.zh: 这是一项国家层面的倡议，国家政府已经承诺。

segments.en: They will allow some kind of cross-boundary innovation elements to be freely flow between Xinjiang and Hong Kong within this park.
segments.zh: 他们将允许一些跨境创新要素在该园区内深圳和香港之间自由流动。

segments.en: So these are something that can be created in other parts of Hong Kong.
segments.zh: 因此，这些是可以在香港其他地区创造的东西。

segments.en: No, mainland China, no, the world. Because we could have mainland data and like mainland biosambles or overseas and Hong Kong biosambles and data
segments.zh: 不，中国内地，不，全世界。因为我们可以拥有内地数据和内地生物样本，或者海外和香港的生物样本和数据。

segments.en: doing this job over in the Loop Hong Kong Park which really makes sense when we talk about IND.
segments.zh: 在河套香港园区开展这项工作，在我们谈论IND时确实很有意义。

segments.en: It is openness that helps IND frives.
segments.zh: 正是开放有助于IND蓬勃发展。
